definitions.gloss: blatant lie; outright lie; barefaced lie
definitions.explanation: An obvious, complete falsehood with no truth whatsoever. The expression uses {真|ま}っ{赤|か} (bright red) metaphorically to mean 'complete' or 'utter.'

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{真|ま}っ{赤|か}な{嘘|うそ}だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{真|ま}っ{赤|か}な{嘘|うそ}だった。
examples.english: His excuse was a blatant lie.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{赤|か}な{嘘|うそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ついて⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}ろう→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧はやめ⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Stop trying to protect yourself by telling blatant lies.

notes:
USAGE:
A set expression meaning a complete, obvious lie. The ⟦{真|ま}っ{赤|か}→真っ赤：03734_makka⟧ here does not refer to the color red but is an intensifier meaning 'utter' or 'complete,' as in {真|ま}っ{赤|か}な{嘘|うそ}. This usage of ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧ as an intensifier also appears in ⟦{真|ま}っ{赤|か}→真っ赤：03734_makka⟧な⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧ (a complete stranger).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|ま}っ{赤|か}な{嘘|うそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つく (to tell a blatant lie)
- {真|ま}っ{赤|か}な{嘘|うそ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見抜|みぬ}く→見抜く：06975_minuku⟧ (to see through a blatant lie)
